stat_scale: Rulebook 1.2.5 working scale, about double Battlegrounds.
shared_rules: ../SHARED-RULES.md is the glossary and the rulings between tribes. Keyword spellings and reminder text here are copied from it; where the two differ, it wins.

rules.renown: Rulebook 11.7.6–7. Only starters and reservists borrow Renown. Fight gains apply next fight.
rules.reserve: Rulebook 11.7.8–10. Hand limit 2 per fight. Guard post, highest Renown, then reading order. Privates follow waiting summons.

keywords.Supply: Works this many times in all, then never again.
keywords.Renown: The unit that starts the fight here, and any reservist who steps in, has +1/+1 for each.
keywords.Reserve: In a fight, this steps from your hand into a slot a friendly unit died in. Your Guard post first. Up to 2 a fight.
keywords.Charge: Works this many times, then stops. Refills each fight.
keywords.Guard post: The unit here has Guard. You have one Guard post.
keywords.Sortie: Attacks the enemy back row while it has units.
keywords.Cleave: Also damages a random unit next to its target.

tokens.name: Private
tokens.implementer: Created by Recruiting Sergeant or Bugler during a fight. It steps in as a reservist outside the hand limit.

units.name: Sentry
units.text: Supply 6: At the end of your turn, give this slot 1 Renown.
reminders: Supply: Works this many times in all, then never again.
Renown: The unit that starts the fight here, and any reservist who steps in, has +1/+1 for each.
units.golden: Supply 6: At the end of your turn, give this slot 2 Renown.
units.implementer: Supply moves with the unit. A triple pools remaining Supply, and a separately created golden starts with six.

units.name: Territorial
units.text: Reserve.
reminders: Reserve: In a fight, this steps from your hand into a slot a friendly unit died in. Your Guard post first. Up to 2 a fight.
units.golden: Reserve.
units.implementer: In hand it is available for Reserve. On the starting board it is a starter.

units.name: Recruiting Sergeant
units.text: Charge 1: After a unit in front of this dies, a Private steps in there.
reminders: Charge: Works this many times, then stops. Refills each fight.
Private: A 2/2 Pigeon reservist.
units.golden: Charge 2: After a unit in front of this dies, a Private steps in there.
units.implementer: Only deaths in the slots in front of the officer qualify. A golden calls normal Privates.

units.name: Lance Corporal
units.text: 1: Give the slots in front of this 2 Renown.
reminders: Renown: The unit that starts the fight here, and any reservist who steps in, has +1/+1 for each.
units.golden: 1: Give the slots in front of this 4 Renown.
units.splash_for: Starting units and hand reservists of any tribe can use the Renown.
units.implementer: The Active needs slots in front of the officer. An empty slot can gain Renown.

units.name: Old Campaigner
units.text: At the start of your turn, give this slot 1 Renown, or 2 if this survived last fight.
reminders: Renown: The unit that starts the fight here, and any reservist who steps in, has +1/+1 for each.
units.golden: At the start of your turn, give this slot 2 Renown, or 4 if this survived last fight.
units.implementer: Use the fight report to check survival of the recruit unit, including a surviving return.

units.name: Colour Sergeant
units.text: At the end of your turn, if this row is full of Pigeons, give each slot in it 2 Renown.
reminders: Renown: The unit that starts the fight here, and any reservist who steps in, has +1/+1 for each.
units.golden: At the end of your turn, if this row is full of Pigeons, give each slot in it 4 Renown.
units.implementer: Check every slot of the current row, including this officer’s slot.

units.name: Padre
units.text: Charge 4: After a friendly unit dies, give its slot 1 Renown.
reminders: Charge: Works this many times, then stops. Refills each fight.
Renown: The unit that starts the fight here, and any reservist who steps in, has +1/+1 for each.
units.golden: Charge 4: After a friendly unit dies, give its slot 2 Renown.
units.splash_for: Deaths of friends of any tribe earn Renown.
units.implementer: Write the gain to the real slot. Reinforcements this fight use the Renown from fight start.

units.name: Grenadier Guard
units.text: 0: Make a slot your Guard post. At the end of your turn, give your Guard post 3 Renown.
reminders: Guard post: The unit here has Guard. You have one Guard post.
Guard: Enemies must attack this first.
Renown: The unit that starts the fight here, and any reservist who steps in, has +1/+1 for each.
units.golden:
0: Make a slot your Guard post.
At the end of your turn, give your Guard post 6 Renown.
units.splash_for: Guard applies to any occupant of the post, including a summon or return.
units.implementer: Moving the Guard post moves its Guard keyword. Renown earned at the old post stays there.

units.name: Squadron Leader
units.text: The units in front of this have Sortie and +3 Attack.
reminders: Sortie: Attacks the enemy back row while it has units.
units.golden: The units in front of this have Sortie and +6 Attack.
units.splash_for: Units of any tribe in front can use Sortie.
units.implementer: While this officer is present, both slots in front lend Sortie and Attack to their occupants.

units.name: Home Guard
units.text: Guard. Reserve.
reminders: Guard: Enemies must attack this first.
Reserve: In a fight, this steps from your hand into a slot a friendly unit died in. Your Guard post first. Up to 2 a fight.
units.golden:
Guard.
Reserve.
units.implementer: Guard applies on the starting board and after entering from hand.

units.name: Flying Ace
units.text: Cleave. Charge 2: After this kills, give this slot 1 Renown.
reminders: Cleave: Also damages a random unit next to its target.
Charge: Works this many times, then stops. Refills each fight.
Renown: The unit that starts the fight here, and any reservist who steps in, has +1/+1 for each.
units.golden:
Cleave.
Charge 2: After this kills, give this slot 2 Renown.
units.implementer: Count kills by this unit, including Cleave. Each kill can spend one Charge.

units.name: Lieutenant
units.text: Start of fight: If this row is full, each unit in it deals half its slot's Renown as damage to the enemy across from it.
reminders: Renown: The unit that starts the fight here, and any reservist who steps in, has +1/+1 for each.
units.golden: Start of fight: If this row is full, each unit in it deals its slot's full Renown as damage to the enemy across from it.
units.implementer: Round down for each slot separately. Use Renown in this fight, including the Colour Ensign’s copy.

units.name: Bugler
units.text: Charge 2: After a friendly unit dies, a Private steps in there.
reminders: Charge: Works this many times, then stops. Refills each fight.
Private: A 2/2 Pigeon reservist.
units.golden: Charge 4: After a friendly unit dies, a Private steps in there.
units.implementer: After hand reservists and waiting summons, call into eligible slots still empty. A golden calls normal Privates.

units.name: Quartermaster
units.text: Recruit: Give a unit in your hand Reserve. You can call 1 more reservist each fight.
reminders: Reserve: In a fight, this steps from your hand into a slot a friendly unit died in. Your Guard post first. Up to 2 a fight.
units.golden:
Recruit: Give 2 units in your hand Reserve.
You can call 2 more reservists each fight.
units.splash_for: A unit of any tribe can gain Reserve.
units.implementer: Grant Reserve permanently. A default grant goes to the leftmost eligible hand unit. Each living Quartermaster raises the hand reserve limit.

units.name: Colour Ensign
units.text: Start of fight: This slot copies your highest Renown.
reminders: Renown: The unit that starts the fight here, and any reservist who steps in, has +1/+1 for each.
units.golden: Start of fight: This slot and the slots next to it copy your highest Renown.
units.implementer: Copy Renown during the start-of-fight setup pass. The real slots retain their own Renown.

units.name: Wing Commander
units.text: Sortie. Start of fight: Your Pigeons with Sortie attack immediately.
reminders: Sortie: Attacks the enemy back row while it has units.
units.golden:
Sortie.
Start of fight: Your Pigeons with Sortie attack immediately, twice.
units.implementer: Each friendly Pigeon with Sortie makes an out-of-turn attack in reading order.

units.name: Group Captain
units.text: Your reservists have Sortie and +4 Attack.
reminders: Sortie: Attacks the enemy back row while it has units.
Reserve: In a fight, this steps from your hand into a slot a friendly unit died in. Your Guard post first. Up to 2 a fight.
units.golden: Your reservists have Sortie and +8 Attack.
units.implementer: The aura covers both hand reservists and Privates for as long as its source is present.

units.name: Regimental Sergeant Major
units.text: At the end of your turn, give every slot 4 Renown.
reminders: Renown: The unit that starts the fight here, and any reservist who steps in, has +1/+1 for each.
units.golden: At the end of your turn, give every slot 8 Renown.
units.splash_for: Starting units of all tribes borrow Renown from their slots.
units.implementer: Each slot gains Renown, including empty slots. There is no slot buff multiplier.

units.name: The Colonel
units.text: Reservists from your hand have double Renown.
reminders: Reserve: In a fight, this steps from your hand into a slot a friendly unit died in. Your Guard post first. Up to 2 a fight.
Renown: The unit that starts the fight here, and any reservist who steps in, has +1/+1 for each.
units.golden: Reservists from your hand have triple Renown.
units.implementer: Only reservists from hand receive the multiplier. Privates receive the ordinary slot value.

units.name: Air Marshal
units.text: Charge 3: After a reservist steps in, it attacks immediately.
reminders: Charge: Works this many times, then stops. Refills each fight.
Reserve: In a fight, this steps from your hand into a slot a friendly unit died in. Your Guard post first. Up to 2 a fight.
units.golden: Charge 6: After a reservist steps in, it attacks immediately.
units.implementer: A friendly reservist makes an out-of-turn attack. Privates qualify.
